title: Jerusalem Jewish Quarter, 2012 — man beside a golden menorah
summary: Caption slide reading Jerusalem, Israel, Jewish Quarter, 2012, beside a photo of a smiling man standing next to a large golden seven-branched menorah in a glass case outdoors in Jerusalem's Jewish Quarter. The last two letters of Israel (el) and the word Jewish are colour-coded.

pictures.description: Photo of a smiling man with glasses and grey hair, in a pink long-sleeved shirt, standing with one hand on a metal railing in front of a tall golden seven-branched menorah displayed inside a curved glass enclosure. Old stone buildings, trees and a blue sky are behind.
pictures.text_in_picture: small signs near the base of the menorah (too small to read)

uncertain: small signs beside the menorah are unreadable
